title: One Shot
description: Makes Minecraft way harder by making mobs stronger
body:
The other day I was looking at Minecraft challenge videos, and I thought:

"What if I could make my own?"

So I made this mod, which makes that dream come true! (sorry I couldn't link the mod to itself. The linking won't work.)

Now every mob is as swole as heck! They have more speed, strength, can survive in lava, and are more durable. Try and beat the game now?
